g.text: J8 pin numbers follow the Waveshare pinout image (pin 1 BAT at the USB-C end, odd pins on the outer row). Power nets are symbols; each net label names the wire it sits on.

g.desc: J8 pin numbers follow the Waveshare pinout image (pin 1 BAT at the USB-C end, odd pins on the outer row). Power nets are symbols; each net label names the wire it sits on.

g.text: 12 V input, reverse-polarity protection, 12 → 5 V buck

g.desc: 12 V input, reverse-polarity protection, 12 → 5 V buck

g.text: MashTouch I/O backpack: MCU-less board on J8 of the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.5

g.desc: MashTouch I/O backpack: MCU-less board on J8 of the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.5

g.text: Edit this sheet in KiCad. After every edit run node tools/kicad/netcheck.js: it lists each pin that changed net since netlist-reference.txt.

g.desc: Edit this sheet in KiCad. After every edit run node tools/kicad/netcheck.js: it lists each pin that changed net since netlist-reference.txt.

g.text: H1–H4: M2 mounting holes on the panel's 4 mm standoffs (not connected).

g.desc: H1–H4: M2 mounting holes on the panel's 4 mm standoffs (not connected).

g.text: Front panel: TCA9535 (0x22) for the two buttons and LED rings

g.desc: Front panel: TCA9535 (0x22) for the two buttons and LED rings

g.text: Power nets are drawn as symbols: every +12V, +5V, +3V3 and GND symbol is the same net. +3V3 comes from the panel (J8 pins 31/32).

g.desc: Power nets are drawn as symbols: every +12V, +5V, +3V3 and GND symbol is the same net. +3V3 comes from the panel (J8 pins 31/32).

g.text: Every output gate has a pull-down: all outputs are off while the ESP32 is in reset or the panel is unplugged.

g.desc: Every output gate has a pull-down: all outputs are off while the ESP32 is in reset or the panel is unplugged.

g.text: OUT1-4: SSR or relay, switched to GND. PWR1-2: 12 V, 3 A, PWM (fan, pump).

g.desc: OUT1-4: SSR or relay, switched to GND. PWR1-2: 12 V, 3 A, PWM (fan, pump).

g.text: Buttons switch to GND. RL (0 Ω) is for rings with a built-in resistor; otherwise fit a series resistor.

g.desc: Buttons switch to GND. RL (0 Ω) is for rings with a built-in resistor; otherwise fit a series resistor.
